attestation: I read AGENTS.md §1 for orientation only and otherwise read only the four brief files (common.md, inventory.md, decisions.md, w4.md), t12-setup.js, the walk-rig scripts (env.sh, walk.mjs) and my own output under apps/e2e/ux-output/walk/w4/. I did not open the captures, any other docs/ file, any decision entry, .prototype/, git history, web-app source or other auditors' outputs; listing docs/roadmap/70-ui-ux/comb-82/ showed that findings/walkthroughs files for w1 and w2 exist, which I did not open. I met no earlier audit ids or wording. I saved no friction note and never touched the notes endpoint; in the development dialog I used only the Persona control (once I briefly read its other controls' labels through the accessibility tree, including the Agent connection list, without operating them). One rig slip: while a menu was open my scripted typing acted as type-ahead and opened the Project details dialog, which I cancelled without changes (noted in Sam's T02-equiv). The walk was interrupted once by an API usage limit during Sam's T09-equiv and resumed with the same daemon and the same data, with nothing redone. At the end I stopped my daemon with common.md § 4's stop commands; the result is reported in my final message.
